info.name: Done Transcription
info.summary: Transcribes Talk calls per speaker and summarises them
info.description:
Automatic transcription and post-call analysis for Nextcloud Talk.
Every participant is captured on their own audio track, so the transcript shows who said what. When a call ends, the transcript is posted to the conversation and turned into a summary with decisions and action items.
Participants can stop recording at any time by posting a command in the room chat; one-to-one calls are only transcribed once the second person answers.
Call audio is captured by a separate transcription service, which this app talks to. The administrator enters its address and token in the admin settings.
info.author: Done
